summary: Postinstall exfiltrates host identifiers and environment to oob.s4yhii.com via HTTP and DNS
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall script collects installer host identifiers (hostname, username, home directory, network interface IPs), CI/build metadata (JENKINS_URL, GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITLAB_CI, CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID, npm_config_registry, PATH, HOME), and the full sorted list of process.env keys, and POSTs the JSON body to the hardcoded endpoint http://oob.s4yhii.com:9999/dep-confusion. A secondary DNS exfiltration channel encodes the hostname and username as hex subdomain labels and resolves them under *.h.dc.oob.s4yhii.com, providing an out-of-band leak path even when outbound HTTP is blocked. The package is published at version 999.0.5 with a /dep-confusion endpoint path, consistent with a dependency-confusion attack targeting internal package name resolution. The behavior fires automatically on install, requires no caller action, and sends installer identity and environment inventory to an attacker-controlled destination regardless of any self-applied 'bug bounty' or 'PoC' labeling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
